title.zh-CN: 上海马拉松：分段累计距离
title.en: Shanghai Marathon: cumulative distance by segment

note.zh-CN: 累计距离按 2026 官方路线图列出的计时点（每 5 公里、半程与终点）排列；官方路线图未标注累计爬升，本图不读取分段爬升。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Cumulative distance follows the timing points on the 2026 official course map (every 5 km, halfway and finish); the map does not label cumulative climb, and this chart reads no per-segment climb. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.

title.zh-CN: 上海马拉松：按 5:45:00 目标完赛算，官方关门点余量（2026 届）
title.en: Shanghai Marathon: official cut-off buffer per gate at a 5:45:00 target (2026)

unit.zh-CN: 分钟（正值为余量，负值为已超关门）

note.zh-CN: 按 2026 官方路线图关门时刻、第一枪 07:00 与目标 5:45:00 完赛匀速推算；余量＝关门时刻−预计到达。靠后分区的分段关门按自然时钟计算，估算时须加回本区发枪差。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Computed from the 2026 official course-map cut-offs, the 07:00 first gun and an even pace to a 5:45:00 finish; buffer = cut-off minus predicted arrival. Gates use wall-clock time for later waves, so add the wave offset back when estimating. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.
